title: JP Cahn's $10,000 offer to Scully

tellings.quote: He approached Scully and offered him $10,000 for the rights to [music] the story, but Scully refused.

plain: In San Francisco in 1950, a journalist named JP Cahn is said to have offered the writer Frank Scully $10,000 for the rights to his story of crashed flying saucers, and Scully turned him down. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about claims that alien bodies were recovered from a crash.
